tools.name: screen_audio
tools.description: Submit a publicly reachable audio or video URL for copyright screening. Returns immediately with a report_id and QUEUED status; the finished result is available from get_screening. Starting a screening is a paid call on the signed-in WIA account (WIA MCP Pro plan or credits).

tools.name: get_screening
tools.description: Fetch the status and result of one screening. When status is COMPLETED, returns every window where a commercial recording was detected, with timestamps and the matched title/artist, plus a plain-language verdict on whether the file is safe to publish.

tools.name: list_screenings
tools.description: List recent screenings with their results. Currently available only to the MusicCheck service API key; accounts signed in through Claude receive an error and look up screenings by report id.

tools.name: verify_report
tools.description: Check that a MusicCheck report id refers to a real screening, and see what it concluded. Needs no sign-in, so anyone can verify a report someone else shows them, for example a claim of "already cleared".
